items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Other brother, Babe, the one was dead. Well, he played like me.

ctx.x: Something like it, yeah. Not even right there. Other brother, Babe, the one was dead. Well, he played like me.
Oh, you got another brother. Well, the one was dead.
